The '''cannon base''' is the first part of the [[dwarf multicannon]] to be set up, followed by the stand. The [[Dwarf Cannon]] [[quest]] must be completed to use it. It is purchased from [[Multicannon parts for sale]] for {{NoCoins|200625}} coins.

The cannon base by itself can decay without having the full cannon set up. When lost, a new cannon base can be obtained from [[Nulodion]], free of charge.
